basis: Calibrated from overall plan dimensions: horizontal 15000mm span pixel x=400 to x=1815 (top dimension line ticks); vertical 8000mm span pixel y=1080(bottom outer wall, world y=0) to y=327(top outer wall, world y=8). Outer footprint uses observed outer wall faces from filled gray wall regions. Interior partitions (two spine walls at px x=889 and x=1392) use measured wall centerlines. Corridor north/south walls at px y=618 and y=804 span full building width, with door apertures at each room-corridor connection measured from door swing arcs in the original drawing.
